newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sixteen dead, scores hurt in Thai road accident.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen dead, scores hurt in Thai road accident.

text.p: Two buses and a truck collided early on Monday morning in northern Thailand, killing at least 16 people and injuring more than 80, many of them critically, police said.

They said a fish container truck smashed into the rear of a bus, which then collided head on with another bus. The accident, Thailand's worst road collision this year, occurred in Klongpai district, about 220 kms (134 miles) northeast of Bangkok.
Twelve people were killed immediately and four others were pronounced dead at a nearby hospital, police said. Eighty-five other people were injured, and 30 of them were listed in critical condition.
More than 100 passengers were in the two buses, police said, adding that the number of deaths might rise.
All the casualties were Thai citizens.
